from common import *
import gzip, shutil, subprocess

def preserve():
    state=read(STATE)
    assert state['phase']=='publication_pending'
    assert len(state['jobs'])==8 and len(state['account_jobs'])==3
    assert all(j['status']=='succeeded' for j in state['jobs']+state['account_jobs'])
    target=BASE/'data'/f'{PREFIX}-boosters';target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    boosters=[]
    for job in state['jobs']:
        source=TMP/f"{job['job_id']}-booster.txt";receipt=fingerprint(source)
        dest=target/f"{receipt['sha256']}.txt.gz"
        if not dest.exists():dest.write_bytes(gzip.compress(source.read_bytes(),mtime=0))
        assert gzip.decompress(dest.read_bytes())==source.read_bytes()
        boosters.append({'job_id':job['job_id'],'source':receipt,'preserved_selected_booster':fingerprint(dest),'original_full_model_retained':job['label']=='old' and job['repeat']==1})
    logs={p.name:p.read_text(errors='replace') for p in sorted(TMP.glob('*.log'))}
    log_file=BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-execution-logs.json.gz'
    log_file.write_bytes(gzip.compress(json.dumps(logs,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2).encode(),mtime=0))
    for p in sorted(TMP.glob('*.py')):register_adapter(p)
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-preservation.json',{'boosters':boosters,'execution_logs':fingerprint(log_file),'adapter_sources':[fingerprint(p) for p in sorted((BASE/'docs').glob(f'{PREFIX}-adapter-*.json'))],'temporary_selected_prediction_arrays':'Numerical comparisons and hashes retained in receipts; redundant arrays removed at closure.'})
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-cleanup.json',{'status':'pending','temporary_root':str(TMP),'preservation':str((BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-preservation.json').relative_to(ROOT)),'planned_duplicate_sessions':[f'p50stable_20261106_{label}_s3000_r{repeat}_original' for label,repeat in [('new',1),('new',2),('old',2)]]})
    print('Selected booster text, full adapter source and execution logs preserved.')

def results():
    cleanup=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-cleanup.json')
    assert cleanup['status']=='pending'
    script=ROOT/'backtest/scripts/maintenance/cleanup_experiment_artifacts.py'
    cmd=[sys.executable,str(script),'--result-retention','platform','--only-result']
    dry=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    doc=json.loads(dry.stdout)
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-result-cleanup-dry-run.json',doc)
    assert not doc['errors'],doc['errors']
    targets={Path(p).name for p in doc['delete_result_dirs']}
    assert targets==set(cleanup['planned_duplicate_sessions']),targets
    inventory=[]
    for raw in doc['delete_result_dirs']:
        p=Path(raw)
        assert p.parent==ROOT/'backtest/result' and p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink()
        inventory.append({'directory':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)),'files':[fingerprint(f) for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')) if f.is_file()]})
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-removed-results.json',{'targets':inventory})
    applied=subprocess.run(cmd+['--apply'],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-result-cleanup-applied.json',json.loads(applied.stdout))
    assert all(not Path(p).exists() for p in doc['delete_result_dirs'])
    cleanup.update(status='results_cleaned',deleted_result_sessions=sorted(targets),mlruns='Not deleted: all three new account runs retained with their report sessions.',result_directory_count=sum(p.is_dir() for p in (ROOT/'backtest/result').iterdir()))
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-cleanup.json',cleanup)
    print(json.dumps(cleanup,ensure_ascii=False))

def temporary():
    cleanup=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-cleanup.json');assert cleanup['status']=='results_cleaned'
    state=read(STATE);assert state['phase']=='publication_pending'
    from backtest.scripts.register.experiment_registry import load_registry
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_archive import ensure_experiment_metadata
    rows=load_registry(ROOT/'backtest/experiments/registry.jsonl')
    row=[r for r in rows if r['exp_id']=='training-target/horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1'][-1]
    assert row.get('stability_followup')
    files=[fingerprint(p) for p in sorted(TMP.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-temporary-cleanup-inventory.json',{'root':str(TMP),'files':files,'ownership':'All files created by this supplementary task; required source, log, selected booster and numerical evidence preserved in parent archive.'})
    assert TMP.name=='qlib-p50-stability-20261106.PleG6F' and TMP.parent==Path('/private/tmp') and not TMP.is_symlink()
    shutil.rmtree(TMP);assert not TMP.exists()
    state.update(status='completed',phase='closed',finished_at=time.time(),cumulative_model_fit_launches=103+state['model_fits_started'],temporary_tools_removed=True)
    write(STATE,state)
    cleanup.update(status='completed',temporary_root_removed=True,completed_at=time.time())
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-cleanup.json',cleanup)
    ensure_experiment_metadata(ROOT,row)
    print('Supplementary stage closed; temporary tools removed; metadata refreshed.')

if __name__=='__main__':
    register_adapter(__file__)
    {'preserve':preserve,'results':results,'temporary':temporary}[sys.argv[1]]()
purpose: Exact task adapter source retained as audit evidence; executable temporary source is removed at closure.
